records.summary: VibeHub does not keep the data layer forward-compatible: every release ships agent-facing migration guidance that restructures a project's old-format .vibehub into the new format

records.title: Decision codex linear whole shell visual baseline
records.summary: The VibeHub DSH product should reskin the whole application toward Codex and Linear quality, not style only the VibeHub-specific surfaces

records.title: Decision dogfood only phase
records.summary: The Skill-first VibeHub has entered a dogfood-only validation phase

records.title: Decision dsh runtime opaque plugin boundary
records.summary: Ship VibeHub first as a non-invasive DSH Plugin while treating every execution mechanism as opaque behind a generic Task-to-Session boundary

records.title: Decision dsh shell with vibehub task pages
records.summary: Keep the DSH application shell and add one or two VibeHub pages derived from the existing Graph Workbench, with Theme Runtime and additive Slots making the whole product coherent

records.title: Decision explicit upgrade migrates safe worktrees
records.summary: Every migration still separates mechanical work from guided semantic judgment, but an explicit VibeHub upgrade now runs and locally commits the mechanical half in every safe registered worktree, reports every skip, never pushes, and leaves semantics to later in-worktree Agent sessions

records.title: Decision external work systems compose into personal tickets
records.summary: Linear, Jira, Feishu, and other organization systems remain useful systems of record whose objects compose into personal VibeHub Tickets as Context, References, actions, Acceptance, and Evidence

records.title: Decision github issues are a read only ticket projection
records.summary: GitHub Issues mirror the checked-in Ticket graph one way from main; Git stays the source of truth and Issue comments are discussion, not durable Context

records.title: Decision goal epic ticket hierarchy
records.summary: Model Goals, Epics and Tickets explicitly with canonical ownership independent of execution dependencies

records.title: Decision human and agent led context spaces
records.summary: Chat and Task share one Work Context substrate but differ by who owns forward motion and whether an execution contract exists

records.title: Decision inbound issue closes into its mirror
records.summary: An outside-filed Issue that becomes a Ticket is closed and pointed at the mirrored Issue of that Ticket, and this handling is implemented in VibeHub rather than performed ad hoc

records.title: Decision migrations declare mechanical and semantic halves
records.summary: Every data-format change must classify its migration into the part code can perform and the part that needs an Agent's judgment; the mechanical part must run on its own, and the semantic part must ship the guidance an Agent needs to write the field well

records.title: Decision native chat with additive task actions
records.summary: Keep ordinary DSH Chat native and unconstrained while adding high-value VibeHub Remember, Plan, and Task interactions through official message-level and turn-tail extension surfaces

records.title: Decision npx is the only supported install path
records.summary: VibeHub supports one install path, npx skills add; host marketplace distribution is retired rather than repaired

records.title: Decision outcome facing attention routing
records.summary: VibeHub presents outcomes and human attention, not Tickets: a consumer-grade router dispatches work to replaceable Agents or people and returns it only when the user is needed

records.title: Decision person centered ticket attention system
records.summary: VibeHub is a person-centered system for all manageable Tickets in a user's information world, using Agents and accumulated Context to execute them and reclaim attention only when it matters

records.title: Decision plugin wedge solo small team coordination
records.summary: VibeHub enters through a lightweight Plugin for one person and small teams coordinating project work, not through organization-scale Linear parity

records.title: Decision project owned or standalone task scope
records.summary: A Task has zero or one owning Project; Projects own their Task scope and Room tree, while standalone Tasks remain valid

records.title: Decision project playbook context guides tickets
records.summary: A known Project owns a Task scope and reusable Room-based playbook Context that teaches VibeHub its workflow, systems, guidance, and completion expectations

records.title: Decision project scope with derived task hierarchy
records.summary: Projects still own normal Tasks and Rooms, but Task hierarchy remains a derived Graph projection rather than an accepted canonical parent-child model

records.title: Decision release and update experience is the mainline
records.summary: This effort is an upgrade of the release and update core experience, with incidental bug fixes attached; the two write-blocked projects are a symptom of it, not the deliverable

records.title: Decision release approval atomically advances main and tag
records.summary: After review, one explicit human-approved Release operation atomically advances main and creates the matching stable tag

records.title: Decision release version identity policy
records.summary: A declared version must move whenever shipped content moves, main between releases carries a pre-release identity, updating is never forced, and an update that is taken must carry the user's data restructure with it

records.title: Decision release version is a computed repository projection
records.summary: A VibeHub version is computed from repository release state; worktrees declare semantic release impact, not independent final version numbers

records.title: Decision retire ticket review skill name
records.summary: vibehub-review 改名 vibehub-review，作为一次刻意的干净断裂发布，不留兼容 stub

records.title: Decision speed first skill plugin
records.summary: VibeHub is a speed-first Skill plugin built from direct Git-native Tickets and Context

records.title: Decision task first human workbench
records.summary: VibeHub is a human-facing Task workbench above Agent sessions: do not manage chat, manage work to completion

records.title: Decision ticket mediates intent context loop
records.summary: One Ticket mediates a loop between human intent and long-term Context

records.title: Decision ticket project independent
records.summary: Superseded: Ticket was previously modeled as project-independent, with Project only an optional view and governance boundary

records.title: Decision ticket routes replaceable agents
records.summary: Ticket is the stable action object that increasingly routes replaceable Agents, while current open source may retain Agent-first entry

records.title: Decision ticket state and local agent sessions
records.summary: Track Ticket workflow state separately from local Agent session observations

records.title: Decision upgrade drives every affected project
records.summary: An explicit upgrade discovers and reports every affected project on the machine, while the migration work itself stays where it already belongs: the next Agent session opened in that project

records.title: Decision vibehub core carries helper for skill copy installers
records.summary: The shared helper, contracts, and templates live inside the non-invocable skills/vibehub-core skill folder so installers that copy skill folders one by one (skills.sh, marketplaces) ship a working VibeHub; npx skills add VW-ai/vibehub-plugin is a supported install path

records.title: Finding npx updates by content not by version
records.summary: skills.sh never reads a declared version; it updates by content hash or unconditional re-fetch, so retiring marketplace distribution makes the observed silent staleness structurally impossible and demotes the version gate from fix to hygiene

records.title: Intent codex native interaction layer
records.summary: VibeHub should explore becoming a contextual interaction layer inside Codex rather than merely placing another standalone task dashboard beside it

records.title: Intent context compounding action system
records.summary: VibeHub aims to become a context-compounding personal action system used across weeks and months, not merely a runtime for one long task

records.title: Intent conversational ticket control surface
records.summary: VibeHub should make project-aware Ticket creation, inspection, steering, Agent dispatch, and attention handoff excellent from conversational surfaces such as a phone

records.title: Intent queryable ticket history by pr and room
records.summary: VibeHub keeps every historical Ticket durably while the active Workbench defaults to current work and offers full-stack queries over archived history by delivery PR and related Rooms

records.title: Intent reproducible public site release
records.summary: VibeHub public-site releases must be reproducible from checked-in instructions and mechanical verification

records.title: Intent user configurable autonomy policy
records.summary: A future hosted VibeHub lets each user tune the tradeoff between Agent autonomy, evidence budget, deviation risk, and human attention

records.title: Note four invariants of modular systems
records.summary: Four system-agnostic invariants govern the skill architecture: decomposition, explicit boundary agreement, deduplicated shared knowledge, and dispatch

records.title: Authority ticket proof schemas
records.summary: The Ticket, Evidence and Outcome schemas plus the revision identity contract are the golden truth of the execution lifecycle

records.title: Change ticket schema adds epic ownership
records.summary: ticket.schema.json gained the optional epic_id field for Goal/Epic ownership

records.title: Constraint acceptance must bind to repository facts
records.summary: 验收判据必须绑定仓库能展示的事实；对会话的否定存在命题无法成为证据

records.title: Decision draft ticket maturity
records.summary: Tickets explicitly state firm or draft maturity; drafts carry direction, become REFINE after blockers resolve, and firm up in place before execution

records.title: Decision lifecycle scoped reference validation
records.summary: 引用校验按生命周期分级：已关闭 Ticket 的引用是记录，对着它自己的 commit 校验

records.title: Change unified dashboard added goal ticket and context workspaces
records.summary: The September unified Dashboard consolidated project and worktree navigation, Goal monitoring, Ticket board and graph views, Inspector detail, and Room-organized Context into one read-only local shell

records.title: Constraint ui quiet intelligence standard
records.summary: Every shared VibeHub UI preserves one A · Quiet Workbench causal layout with a left-to-right default and top-to-bottom choice

records.title: Constraint unified dashboard restores graph and filter parity
records.summary: The unified Dashboard may keep its new shell only if it retains the accepted Workbench's graph orientation, dense-layout, and composable visibility capabilities

records.title: Contract canonical agent output
records.summary: Schema-valid Agent output is the sole handoff contract for mechanical consumers

records.title: Decision context anchored task intervention
records.summary: Human interaction occurs inside the Task Context Space through explicit anchors and actions, while runtime steering remains an adapter concern

records.title: Decision dashboard classifies worktree format before graph load
records.summary: The multi-worktree Dashboard classifies project-format compatibility before graph loading and gives legacy worktrees an exact read-only upgrade handoff instead of a generic validation failure

records.title: Decision local graph ui first class
records.summary: The comprehensive local Ticket graph UI is a first-class VibeHub surface

records.title: Decision public canvas scrolls diagonally
records.summary: The public site explains VibeHub before its causal canvas adds visual character

records.title: Decision public causal canvas site
records.summary: The public VibeHub website uses the Ticket graph as its site-wide spatial language

records.title: Decision public hero shows ticket graph
records.summary: The public hero must unmistakably present VibeHub as a Ticket graph product

records.title: Decision topology derived task clusters
records.summary: Task clusters are stable view projections derived from the dependency DAG; topology owns membership and AI may supply only human-facing semantics

records.title: Decision unified work graph semantic zoom
records.summary: One Global Work Graph presents Task and Chat Context nodes, then uses semantic zoom to reveal Task topology or Conversation streams without competing graph products

records.title: Decision workbench state signal and action priority
records.summary: Keep the production Ticket card visually stable: express truthful live activity and one upper-right substate, while making Recommended action the focused panel's dominant interaction

records.title: Intent unified dashboard keeps structure and moves to quiet glass
records.summary: Keep the unified Dashboard's clearer production-ready structure, but move its surface language away from decorative gradients toward restrained cool-neutral liquid glass

authorities.summary: The Context and Room JSON Schemas are the golden truth for every durable knowledge document VibeHub reads or writes
